_notes: CA public hospital district, Fremont/Newark/Union City (Alameda County). 415-bed. Two debt classes: revenue bonds (Baa2 stable from Moody's after 2022 affirmation) and GOULT bonds (A1 from Moody's). 2023 GO issuance assigned Baa3 stable per one source — needs verification. Smaller district hospital. Measure B parcel tax on Nov 2025 ballot.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's affirms Washington Township Health Care District's (CA) Baa2 (revenue bonds); outlook negative. Jan 10 2022 action carried into window. WTHCD has approximately $219M revenue-backed debt.
